# Best Wide-Rule Black Marble Composition Books for 100-Count Sets

 March 16, 2026 

This guide highlights top wide-rule black marble composition books that come in 100-sheet packages, ideal for students, professionals, and planners who want durable notebooks with ample writing space. Each selection emphasizes sturdy bindings, classic marble covers, and roomy ruled pages to support organized note-taking across classrooms, offices, and creative projects. Explore five reliable options designed to keep notes neat and secure, plus a practical buying guide to compare features like binding, sheet count, and portability.

| Product | Brand |
| --- | --- |
| Mead Composition Notebook, 3 Pack, Wide Ruled | Mead Store |
| 4 Pack – EPI Marble Hardcover Wide Ruled | EPI Store |
| BAZIC Composition Book Wide Ruled 100 Sheet | BAZIC PRODUCTS Store |
| Mead Composition Notebook, 3 Pack, College Ruled | Mead Store |
| Rosmonde Composition Notebook Wide Ruled 5 Pack | Rosmonde Store |

Note: The products below feature wide-ruled or college-ruled lines on sturdy marble-pattern covers, designed to support clear, legible handwriting across long note-taking sessions. Each item offers 100 sheets or 200 pages in a compact size, suitable for backpacks and desk drawers alike.

## Mead Wide Rule Marble Composition Notebook 100 Sheets

The Mead Composition Notebook in black marble offers 100 double-sided sheets with wide-ruled lines, giving ample space for notes, assignments, and quick drafts. Its sewn binding lays flat when open, helping students and professionals maintain a neat writing surface. The durable cover helps protect contents during daily transport, making it a dependable choice for classes and on-the-go note-taking.

## EPI Marble Hardcover Wide Ruled Notebook — 200 Pages

This 4-pack from EPI includes black marble hardcover composition notebooks with a total of 200 pages (100 double-sided sheets per book). The sturdy sewn binding ensures the pages stay secure, while the compact 9.75 x 7.5-inch size makes them easy to carry. Ideal for students and professionals who need organized space for notes, ideas, and plans across multiple subjects or projects.

## BAZIC Wide Rule 100-Sheet Marble Notebook

BAZIC’s black marble composition book provides 100 sheets of wide-ruled paper, offering a classic notebook experience in a portable 9.75″ x 7.5″ format. The front cover includes a space for name and class details, while the wide-ruled layout helps maintain neat, legible handwriting. This option is well-suited for daily class tasks, journaling, and quick notes on the go.

## Mead College-Ruled Black Marble Composition Book

The Mead college-ruled notebook pairs classic black marble aesthetics with a college ruled format, featuring 100 double-sided pages. The cover includes a compact schedule and reference tables to support aging students and professionals who require more lines per page for detailed notes, calculations, or writing tasks. This edition emphasizes organization and easy reference during lectures and meetings.

## Rosmonde Wide Rule Marble Notebook 5-Pack

The Rosmonde five-pack delivers a bulk set of wide-ruled notebooks with durable sewn bindings. Each book contains 100 sheets (200 pages), suitable for organized class notes, project planning, and office tasks. The assortment makes it easy to assign a notebook per subject or project while maintaining a consistent marble aesthetic and writing space.

### Buying Guide

- Binding and durability: Look for sewn bindings that reduce loose pages and ensure pages lie flat for comfortable writing. Marble covers offer a durable, all-purpose design that withstands daily use.
- Sheet count and ruling: Choose wide-ruled for relaxed handwriting or college-ruled for more lines per page. Confirm whether the notebook provides 100 sheets per book or 200 pages total when selecting multi-pack sets.
- Size and portability: Common sizes like 9.75 x 7.5 inches balance readability with portability. Smaller sizes fit into backpacks and purses, while larger options may suit extended note-taking sessions.
- Front matter and extras: Some notebooks include class schedules, conversion tables, or grammar rules on the inside covers, which can help with quick reference during coursework or meetings.
- Use case: For students, prioritize notebooks that support subject organization; for professionals, consider options with durable covers and ample writing space for minutes and ideas.
- Value and variety: Multi-packs offer cost savings and the flexibility to dedicate notebooks to different subjects, teams, or projects without sacrificing consistency in design.
